title: The secret behind Ciri's father in The Witcher 3
subject: ciri
description:
Could you forgive a father like Emhyr? 👇

The hidden identity of Ciri's father and why he wants her back in The Witcher 3. Spoilers for The Witcher saga and The Witcher 3.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CD PROJEKT RED. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: The emperor who conquered Ciri's homeland was her own father.
Years earlier, a knight cursed with a hedgehog's face married her mother, Princess Pavetta.
His name was Duny. When Ciri was small, he and Pavetta were lost at sea.
Duny survived. He returned as Emhyr var Emreis, Emperor of Nilfgaard, and his armies took Cintra.
In The Witcher 3 quest Imperial Audience, he summons Geralt to Vizima and pays him to find her.
He wants his daughter home, but even more, an heir for his throne.
For years, Ciri had been running from her own father.
